title: Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation for Shortcut Removal in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33904v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time. This can lead to poor predictions when correlations shift. Most existing solutions for removing shortcuts operate at training time, requiring labeled training data, model weight access, and significant computational resources. Here, we study the problem of test-time shortcut removal. We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM's predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. translated_title: 面向语言模型捷径消除的反事实测试时增强方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可能会利用捷径，即训练数据中存在但在测试时可能不成立的关联性。当这些关联性发生偏移时，可能导致糟糕的预测结果。现有的大多数消除捷径的方案在训练阶段运行，需要标注的训练数据、模型权重访问权限以及大量计算资源。本文研究测试时捷径消除问题。我们提出了一族反事实测试时增强（CTTA）方法：给定一个样本，每种方法使用辅助模型生成改变捷径值的反事实编辑，然后对这些编辑上LLM的预测结果进行加权平均。我们证明了最优的捷径不变预测器属于该CTTA方法族，并刻画了其权重特征。这些权重取决于训练分布，因此在一般情况下，仅凭训练后的模型和无标注数据无法识别这些权重。
tldr: 该论文提出反事实测试时增强（CTTA）方法，通过辅助模型生成改变捷径值的反事实编辑并对LLM预测加权平均，无需标注数据或模型权重访问权限即可在测试阶段消除大语言模型的捷径依赖，且从理论上证明了最优捷径不变预测器属于该方法族并刻画了其权重。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods that use an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits changing the shortcut value and take a weighted average of the LLM's predictions, enabling test-time shortcut removal in LLMs without requiring labeled data or model weight access, and theoretically proves that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor belongs to this CTTA family with characterized weights.
